# Chrono tyre files

Two Magic Formula PAC2002 property files from Project Chrono, copied unchanged on 2026-11-13 so that
`tests/suspension-tyre.test.ts` can check the sets in `src/vehicle/tyre-data.ts` against them number by number.

- `Sedan_Pac02Tire.tir`: <https://github.com/projectchrono/chrono/blob/main/data/vehicle/sedan/tire/Sedan_Pac02Tire.tir>
- `mf_185_80R14.tir`: <https://github.com/projectchrono/chrono/blob/main/data/vehicle/VW_microbus/json/mf_185_80R14.tir>
